scope.question: Define a repository-native, durable maintenance and operations factory from intake through recurrence prevention, including user reports, telemetry/logs, CI, security alerts, dependency updates, incidents, bounded remediation, rollout/rollback, postmortems and governed improvement.
boundaries: The controller coordinates maintenance work; existing observability, paging, scanners, GitHub, CI/CD and workflow engines remain systems of record for their own facts.
Incident mitigation and planned defect repair share evidence but have different clocks and authority. Paging restores service; backlog work produces reviewed code.
The model does not make raw logs/issues authoritative, does not diagnose by confidence alone, and does not claim safe general autonomous operations.

The target maximum for fully self-improving is automatic proposal, offline evaluation, non-operative shadow, bounded canary, and automatic rollback for proven reversible classes. Protected tests, hidden holdouts, graders, permissions, policy, risk floors and promotion authority remain outside the candidate.
scope.as_of: 2026-09-13; foundational incident/workflow evidence before 2023 is included where still normative.

verified_capabilities: GitHub webhooks expose typed issue, CI/check, code-security and deployment events. Official guidance requires HMAC validation, quick acknowledgement, asynchronous queues and use of delivery identifiers; failed deliveries are not automatically redelivered, so durable intake plus inventory reconciliation is necessary [S49-S52].

Dependabot supports scheduled/grouped/cooldown-limited version-update PRs, vulnerability alerts and minimum-secure-version security PRs; dependency review can gate newly introduced dependencies [S01-S04]. Renovate supports grouping, stability delay and conditional automerge, subject to platform checks and permissions [S08-S10].

CodeQL Autofix and Sentry Seer can propose fixes/PRs and correlate telemetry, but their own documentation says generated fixes can be incomplete, insecure, syntactically wrong or behavior-changing. This supports diagnosis/proposal, not autonomous acceptance [S06-S07,S24-S25].

OpenTelemetry provides correlated traces, metrics and logs; W3C Trace Context provides propagation. Prometheus/Alertmanager supports persistence, firing/resolved status, grouping and webhooks. None proves root cause or safe action [S26-S28,S57].

Argo Rollouts and Kubernetes provide deterministic progressive analysis, abort/pause and rollback primitives. GitHub environments add protected deployment jobs and scoped secrets. These are credible actuation substrates only when metrics, artifact identity and protection configuration are correct [S29,S38,S40,S53-S54].

NIST incident guidance and Google SRE practice support explicit incident roles, communication, evidence, recovery and lessons learned. PagerDuty exposes logged human-triggered automation actions for known runbooks [S31,S37,S58-S59].

SLSA provenance, artifact signature verification, GitHub rulesets and Actions hardening can bind a release to reviewed build inputs and separate trusted workflows. Provenance authenticates origin; it does not establish semantic safety [S05,S12,S19,S56].

GitHub deployment records/statuses are requests and externally reported observations, not a general production rollback mechanism; GitHub Revert creates a new source PR and may conflict [S65-S68]. Runtime rollback must live in the deployer and restore an immutable known-good artifact.

GitHub required checks can mask a skipped Actions job as success. Merge queues require CI to handle merge_group. Verify expected App/check identity, exact SHA and actual evidence rather than check name/conclusion alone [S64,S67].

RFC 9116 standardizes discoverable vulnerability-report contact metadata, while NIST SP 800-216 supplies a receive→scope→triage→coordinate→verify/remediate→communicate process; neither makes security intake autonomous [S72-S73]. CVSS v4 separates intrinsic severity from time/local context and must not be used as the sole priority [S74].

evidence_and_limits.supported_conclusion: Compose deterministic intake/reconciliation, independent protected verification, existing incident command, and narrowly scoped runbooks. Let models summarize, search, cluster candidates, draft hypotheses/plans/patches and propose improvements. Never let model prose itself grant authority.
independent_challenges: Empirical Dependabot studies report real adoption and repair activity but also non-merge, compatibility and workflow friction; alert/PR creation is not equivalent to retained remediation [S16-S17,S20-S21].
GitHub dependency graphs can be incomplete/inaccurate for studied ecosystems; scanner absence is not proof of no vulnerability [S22].
Knight Capital, Cloudflare and Meta outage records show automation/configuration defects can produce extreme blast radius and that rollback paths may themselves fail [S34-S36].

Patch-generation research distinguishes plausible/test-passing patches from correct patches. AI incident benchmarks measure bounded task performance, not production authorization or long-horizon safety [S45-S48].
The event-stream supply-chain incident shows a seemingly ordinary dependency update can transfer attacker code; trust, provenance and maintainer history matter beyond semver/test green [S18].
missing_denominators: No normalized public dataset reports total signals, dedupe errors, true/false issue creation, diagnosis correctness, operator effort, safe remediation, rollback success and recurrence across the same production population.

Vendor case studies generally omit selection, failed attempts, review labor, false RCA, post-deployment defects and cost. Sentry self-use is a useful case report, not independent causal validation [S39].
Living GitHub/product documentation and plan-specific behavior must be snapshotted and contract-tested on the target tenant.
evidence_and_limits.safe_inference: Automatic rollback may be safer than novel repair only for a pretested compatible artifact and reversible side effects. Missing/conflicting telemetry, data migrations, credential compromise or rollback failure require incident command.

actors_and_authority.external_reporter: May submit symptoms and answer questions; owns no state transitions. Identity, consent and visibility are recorded.
actors_and_authority.intake_adapter: Authenticates source, redacts, normalizes and stores envelopes; no issue/deploy rights.
actors_and_authority.controller: Only component allowed to append lifecycle transitions. Enforces schema, CAS/fencing, risk, budgets, approval invalidation and outbox. It is deterministic and cannot change its own policy.
actors_and_authority.triage_agent: Reads sanitized evidence; proposes cluster links, severity, hypotheses and questions. Cannot page, publish, dismiss, prioritize, close or execute.
actors_and_authority.on_call_and_incident_roles: Human incident commander owns incident declaration, severity, objectives and break-glass; operations lead executes/coordinates; communications lead handles stakeholder messages; planning lead tracks work [S58].
actors_and_authority.planner_implementer: Creates a versioned remediation proposal and task-branch patch with short-lived, path/verb/budget-scoped credentials. Cannot approve, merge, deploy, access production secrets or modify protected controls.
actors_and_authority.verifier: Independent identity executes protected tests/security/policy and signs evidence for exact SHA/artifact. Cannot edit candidate or approve release.
actors_and_authority.publisher_reconciler: Narrow identity creates/updates issues and managed Project fields idempotently; imports or flags human-owned drift; no code/deploy permission.
actors_and_authority.merge_deploy_rollback: Separate controllers accept only signed policy decisions. Deploy identity receives environment/OIDC authority after required gate. Rollback controller can restore only allowlisted, drilled last-known-good versions.
actors_and_authority.security_privacy_owner: Owns embargo/private routing, disclosure, alert dismissal, risk acceptance and evidence retention/deletion.
actors_and_authority.policy_eval_owners: Humans/independent services own hidden tests, graders, thresholds, permissions, rulesets, promotion and exception approval. Candidate cannot read/write protected answer keys or approve itself.
actors_and_authority.separation_invariant: No principal may propose and satisfy its own independent gate, expand its permissions, alter evidence, or weaken the policy that judges its action.

complete_state_catalog.terminal_rule: Terminal is aggregate-specific. CLOSED never erases history; recurrence appends a new revision and either reopens by declared same-problem policy or creates a linked successor. CANCELLED records actor, reason and cleanup result.

event_envelope.subject: aggregate id
event_envelope.versions: adapter, fingerprint, policy, model/prompt/tool, repository SHA, runbook, evaluator

transition_contract.command: {command_id, requested_transition, subject, expected_version, idempotency_key, actor, capability, deadline, budget, bound_approval?, reason, payload_digest}. Controller validates and records accepted/rejected result.
guards: authenticated and schema-supported source; privacy route permits processing
current state/version and valid fencing token match
risk is max(declared, deterministic source/path/capability/runtime floor); agents cannot lower it
all required evidence is fresh and bound to exact spec/SHA/artifact/policy/runbook
approval actor is independent, authorized, unexpired and bound to immutable proposal hash
budget, error budget, maintenance window, concurrency key and rollback prerequisites allow action

Security priority combines CVSS vector, current threat/exploitation, local environment/asset criticality, reachability, business impact and disclosure duty; base score alone cannot authorize dismissal or execution [S74].
transition_contract.effects: Within one DB transaction append event, change aggregate version, create evidence/audit references and insert outbox command. External writes occur later, carry deterministic marker, then are read back before success transition.
transition_contract.idempotency_ordering: Unique(source,delivery_id) and unique(subject,transition,candidate_digest,policy_version). Duplicate commands return prior outcome. Store out-of-order evidence but never regress state. Use per-aggregate CAS/lease and fencing; late worker output cannot publish.
invalidation: New material user decision => new decision/spec revision; invalidate READY and downstream approval.
New commit/base, artifact, policy, evaluator, runbook parameters, evidence revision, scope/permission or expired time => invalidate bound approval and verification.
Source resolves then re-fires inside cooldown => cancel closure; materially different ownership/cause => linked successor.
transition_contract.reconciliation: Webhooks wake work but are not completeness proof. Periodically inventory sources, alerts, workflow runs, issues/PRs/deployments and managed Project/ruleset/environment configuration. Classify drift as safe-managed, human-owned, destructive, unknown or missing. Repair only preapproved idempotent managed drift; import allowed human decisions; otherwise SYNC_ERROR and stop.
transition_contract.invalid_transition: Persist rejection with policy rule/evidence and alert if safety relevant. Never infer success from timeout, missing webhook, green summary, silence, or HTTP 2xx.

immutable_evidence: raw-event-ref.json: encrypted object URI, ciphertext/hash, source revision, authenticity, DLP result, retention/legal-hold; raw secrets/PII/embargoed findings never enter normal GitHub issues.
normalized-signal.v1.json: signal kind, detector/rule/version, repo/service/component/environment, severity/status, signature, first/last seen/count and evidence refs.
cluster.vN.json: fingerprint algorithm/version, exact fields, aliases/merge-split lineage, owners, source membership, decisions and confidence labels fact|inference|unknown.
incident.v1.json: severity, commander/roles, objectives, timeline, affected services/users, communications, mitigations, state and evidence.
diagnosis.v1.json: reproduction environment/commit, observations, ranked hypotheses, supporting/refuting evidence, experiments, counterfactuals, uncertainty and stop criteria.
remediation-plan.v1.json: immutable decision/spec revision, scope/non-goals, risk, steps, tests, rollout, rollback/compensation, owners, budgets and approvals.

runbook.v1.yaml: signed ID/version/digest, eligible fingerprint/risk, typed parameters and bounds, preconditions, resource/concurrency lock, exact operations, credential profile, timeout, independent postconditions, compensator, last drill, expiry and human-only predicates.
evidence-bundle.v1.json: base/head, build image, test/evaluator manifests, raw result digests, provenance, policy result and verifier identity.
release-manifest.v1.json: source/artifact/SBOM/provenance/signature, config/schema compatibility, cohort/budgets, observation queries, abort thresholds and last-known-good.

postmortem.v1.md+json: impact, detection, timeline, contributing conditions/failed defenses, trigger, mitigation/recovery, evidence, what went well/poorly, owned/dated actions and recurrence/eval candidates; avoid monocausal or model-invented RCA.
decision.v1.json: question, options/tradeoffs, recommendation, exact human response, actor/time, affected artifact hashes, resulting revision, expiry/supersession and rationale.

effect-receipt.v1.json: requested operation and idempotency key, target/resource pre-state, provider operation ID, HTTP/result, observed post-state, ambiguity classification and compensating action; deployment status is observation rather than proof of runtime change [S65-S66].
artifact_contracts.provenance: Every derived artifact lists input content hashes, producing code/model/prompt/tool versions, actor, timestamp, redaction/transformation and output digest. Mutable URLs are evidence references, not identities.
artifact_contracts.storage: Git stores reviewed schemas/policy/runbook definitions and opaque evidence hashes. Restricted immutable/object storage holds telemetry, security cases, hidden evals and audit. Controller DB is operational truth. GitHub issue/Project fields are projections.
artifact_contracts.compatibility: Schemas use additive-first semver; consumers reject unknown unsafe major versions. Migrations shadow/replay fixtures, retain lineage/aliases and support rollback or dual read.
artifact_contracts.retention: Per privacy/legal/service policy with lineage-aware deletion and a non-sensitive audit tombstone. Failed, cancelled and rolled-back outcomes remain auditable.

conversation_and_handoffs.durable_dialogue: Every question and answer becomes a versioned Decision artifact, not only a comment. The controller posts a human-readable rendering plus stable decision ID; it ingests the authenticated answer, quotes it exactly, records actor/source/time, creates a new spec/plan revision and computes which approvals/evidence became stale.
ask_policy: Ask one grouped, bounded set of questions when missing facts can change user-visible behavior, security/privacy/legal duties, severity/priority, data loss, compatibility, public communication, ownership, acceptance oracle, blast radius or rollback.
Provide options, evidence/tradeoffs and a recommended default only when reversible and permitted. Never silently choose consequential product intent.
After configured attempts/TTL, move to BLOCKED/DEFERRED and notify owner; do not fabricate intent or burn implementation budget.
conversation_and_handoffs.incident_handoff: Record outgoing/incoming commander, current objectives/state, executed commands, open hypotheses, next checks, timers, permissions and exact acknowledgement. Until accepted, HANDOFF_PENDING retains old accountable commander.
conversation_and_handoffs.agent_handoff: Structured context manifest contains work/spec revision, repository/base SHA, cluster/incident timeline, evidence digests, decisions, attempted experiments, remaining budget, lease/fence and explicit next action. Receiver verifies digests and acknowledges; free-form summary is non-authoritative.
conversation_and_handoffs.compaction_resume: Compact by artifact references and signed checkpoint, never by deleting decisions. Resume requires re-read of current aggregate, remote reconciliation, lease/approval/evidence freshness check and mismatch report before action.
conversation_and_handoffs.closure: Reporter/user confirmation is sought for user-visible bugs when feasible. Lack of response can close after declared policy/cooldown only with verified telemetry/tests, never by assuming satisfaction.

orchestration_and_composition.topology: MaintenanceFactory composes Intake, Cluster/Triage, Incident, Diagnosis, PlannedChange, Release/Rollback and Postmortem/Improvement subfactories. A parent owns correlation and join policy; each child has separate state, lease, budget and authority.
fanout: Parallel evidence collectors may query logs/traces/deploys/CI/security/dependency/repository history read-only.
Hypothesis agents may independently analyze sanitized snapshots. Their outputs join as claims with cited evidence; disagreement triggers experiment/human review, never majority truth.
Security-private work and public backlog never share raw artifacts or credentials. Incident mitigation continues even if Project/issue projection fails.
orchestration_and_composition.joins: Join declares required, optional and veto outputs. Timeout yields INCONCLUSIVE with missing branches. A critical security/privacy/policy veto blocks regardless of other success. Late child results append evidence but cannot mutate a completed revision.
orchestration_and_composition.dependencies: DAG edges name artifact contract, exact producer revision, start condition, cancellation propagation and compensation. Cycles are prohibited except explicit bounded clarification/retry loops.
orchestration_and_composition.budgets: Per case and child: wall time, attempts, tokens, cost, tool calls, log bytes, evidence age, concurrency and production blast radius. Reserve budget for cleanup/rollback. Exceed => cancel children, revoke lease/token, preserve evidence and escalate.
orchestration_and_composition.cleanup: Finally paths revoke tokens, release locks, stop sandboxes, remove ephemeral resources, reconcile partial writes, archive evidence and expose cleanup_failed. Cleanup failure is never hidden by task success.
orchestration_and_composition.workflow_engine: PostgreSQL inbox/outbox/CAS is enough initially. A durable workflow engine may replace scheduling at measured scale, but policy/authority/artifact contracts stay external to LLM agents.

deterministic_always_human: ambiguous or contested user intent/priority; new public behavior/API; legal/privacy/customer communication
Sev-1/2 declaration/closure, novel production action, destructive/irreversible/data/schema/IAM/auth/crypto operation, cross-region/global action
security alert dismissal/risk acceptance/public disclosure; dependency supplier trust exception; secret/PII handling
new or materially changed runbook, fingerprint/noise/routing policy, detector, evaluator/grader/hidden test, permission, workflow trust, ruleset/environment/CODEOWNERS
failed/incompatible rollback, missing/conflicting telemetry, unknown provenance, expired evidence/approval, break-glass/exception
promotion of any agent/model/prompt/tool/policy/workflow improvement; proposer cannot count as approver
vulnerability report scope dispute, safe-harbor/legal issue, coordinated disclosure timing, or reporter communication with material commitment [S72-S73]
may_automate_only_if_all: allowlisted low-risk class and exact versioned runbook or patch-dependency profile
deterministic preconditions and independent postconditions; small bounded blast radius; reversible/drilled rollback
current signed evidence/provenance and no policy/config/source-health drift
local pilot meets predefined per-class precision, miss, escape, rollback and operator-load thresholds with enough denominators
automatic circuit breaker, manual kill switch, scoped identity, idempotency and audited sampled review
human_need_policy.probabilistic_use: Model confidence may rank triage/hypotheses or select questions, but cannot override a deterministic gate. If calibrated uncertainty exceeds class threshold or independent agents/graders disagree beyond threshold, request evidence/human review; an uncalibrated score is treated as unknown.
human_need_policy.approval_binding: Bind work/incident ID, decision/spec revision, evidence digest, exact SHA/artifact, runbook+parameters, policy/evaluator versions, resource scope, approver stable identity/role, reason and expiry. Any bound change invalidates.
human_need_policy.stop: On unauthorized tool attempt, secret detection, scope/permission expansion, stale fence, impossible transition, repeated same failure, budget breach, policy drift, inconclusive health, rollback failure or kill signal: stop writes, revoke credentials, preserve evidence and page accountable owner.
cannot_safely_be_autonomous: choosing product priorities or interpreting unresolved human values
declaring a novel root cause as fact or accepting a model-authored test as sole oracle
granting its own permissions, weakening gates, modifying protected tests/graders/holdouts or approving/prompting its own promotion
novel high-blast-radius remediation, destructive migration, security disclosure/risk acceptance, legal/customer commitments, or recovery when rollback is unproven
general unattended issue→production→self-modification. No reviewed evidence establishes safe broad autonomy.

schema_rules: Unknown fields rejected in authority-bearing objects; symbolic external IDs resolved into non-authoritative observed lock state.
All refs and executable artifacts pin version+digest. Secrets, raw telemetry and mutable observed state are excluded from Git.
Schema CI tests reachability, terminal states, guards, authority separation, retry/cleanup paths and backward compatibility.

end_to_end_workflows.name: user report to retained fix
steps: Authenticate reporter/source; create redacted envelope; search stable markers/fingerprints and semantic candidates.
Ask reproducibility/expected-behavior questions; store answers as Decision revisions. Human priority/intent yields READY.
Reproduce at exact base, record diagnosis/hypotheses, approve remediation plan, patch task branch.
Independent verifier proves baseline failure/candidate pass plus protected suites; review/merge exact SHA.
Deploy signed artifact by risk policy; canary on SLO/user evidence; rollback on declared threshold.
After cooldown and reporter confirmation when feasible, close cluster/work; recurrence links to postmortem/eval.

end_to_end_workflows.name: CI failure
steps: Key exact occurrence by repository/workflow/job/head/attempt plus normalized error signature; distinguish same-commit rerun from recurrence.
One allowlisted transient rerun is permitted; repeated/unknown/security failures block. Correlate last pass, dependency/action/runtime changes.
Agent may draft diagnosis/patch within two attempts; clean trusted CI on exact head decides. Never let privileged workflow execute attacker-controlled artifact.

end_to_end_workflows.name: security or dependency maintenance
steps: Route secret/embargoed finding privately; preserve advisory/rule/package/ecosystem/manifest and affected-range identity.
Prioritize deterministic severity/exposure plus CISA KEV/EPSS as signals, not sole decisions [S14-S15]. Verify dependency graph/SBOM and exploitability; scanner absence is inconclusive [S22].
Bot proposes minimum secure/grouped update; verify supplier/provenance, lockfile delta, dependency review, tests and compatibility. CodeQL autofix remains a suggestion [S01-S07].
Only allowlisted patch updates with mature local evidence may auto-merge/canary; majors, new suppliers, scripts, auth/crypto or failed tests require review. Humans own dismiss/risk accept/disclose.

end_to_end_workflows.name: active incident and rollback
steps: Actionable symptom/SLO/security signal creates incident candidate; human/on-call declares severity and incident roles. Preserve timeline and separate mitigation from RCA.
Prefer stop-the-bleeding: abort rollout, disable preapproved flag, shed bounded load, or restore drilled last-known-good using signed runbook. Lock resource and verify preconditions.
Execute with short-lived operation identity; observe independent user/SLO postconditions. Ambiguous telemetry, side-effect mismatch or rollback failure => HUMAN_INCIDENT.
After recovery/cooldown, preserve evidence and hand planned code changes into normal READY/verification/release gates; incident urgency does not permanently bypass them.

end_to_end_workflows.name: postmortem and recurrence prevention
steps: Open POSTMORTEM_REQUIRED for severe, repeated, rollback, control or near-miss criteria. Agent drafts factual timeline from immutable events; humans review impact/contributors.
Create owned dated actions across detection, prevention, containment, rollback, runbook, tests and policy. Each action is a work item, not a checkbox in prose.

Curator converts verified failure to minimized eval fixture with provenance/privacy and protected oracle. Candidate improvement runs offline, shadow and canary. Independent owner promotes; adverse late result rolls back and reopens learning.

end_to_end_workflows.name: controller/source outage
steps: Freeze publishers/executors if auth/policy/evidence integrity is unavailable; keep known-good production and paging independent.
Restore DB/object/audit from tested backup, replay durable inbox with idempotency, inventory upstream/GitHub remote actual state, surface gaps/conflicts.
Canary one source and reconcile before general enablement; create incident/postmortem for loss or unauthorized mutation.

automated_loop: Observe retained outcome, false merge/split, incident, rollback, operator correction and sampled success.
Draft sanitized postmortem action/eval candidate. Independent curator validates oracle, provenance, privacy and time-split holdout.
Agent proposes one minimal change to prompt/model/router/tool/fingerprint/workflow/runbook with hypothesis, cost and rollback digest.
Run deterministic tests, repeated stochastic trials, adversarial/metamorphic cases and protected holdout with independent evaluator.
Shadow production inputs with all side effects forced to sinks. Compare against current control by slice.
After external promotion approval, canary signed digest with fixed cohort/time/action/spend/error budgets and auto-abort.
Promote only through independent authority. Monitor delayed effects; automatically restore compatible known-good on declared reversible threshold; open new case.
protected_invariants: candidate cannot see/write hidden expected results, evaluator/grader config, acceptance thresholds or audit
candidate cannot change permissions, identities, policy, risk floors, gates, CODEOWNERS/rulesets/environments or promotion decision
candidate cannot select only favorable evidence, rewrite failed runs or delete incident/rollback history
authorization safety is a hard veto; aggregate score cannot trade it for productivity
production artifact equals evaluated digest and rollback target is pretested/compatible
self_improvement_boundary.maximum_safe_claim: Proposal/evaluation/shadow/canary/rollback can be automatic for a narrow proven reversible class. Promotion authority and any change to the control plane stay independent and human-accountable. Auto-promotion is not recommended without external preauthorization of an immutable policy and ample local evidence; control-plane changes are never auto-promoted.
self_improvement_boundary.recurrence_metric: Measure retained resolution after 7/30/90-day class-specific windows, reopened clusters, same-cause incidents, action completion/effect, false dedupe split/merge, escape severity, rollback success, human corrections, review/on-call cost and user/SLO outcome—not tickets closed.

schema_contract: Validate every YAML/JSON artifact against pinned schema; golden canonicalization/digest; reject unknown authority fields; compatibility/expand-migrate-contract tests.
Consumer-driven contracts for GitHub webhook/API, OTel/Alertmanager, scanners, CI, deployment and Project schemas on target tenant/version.
state_model: Enumerate every state/event/role/risk combination; prove no unreachable states, unauthorized path to READY/MERGED/PROMOTED/CLOSED, terminal mutation, missing cleanup or unbounded loop.

Property-based/random command sequences: monotonic aggregate versions; at-most-once logical effect; duplicate/reordered events converge; stale fence/approval never publishes; closure requires evidence/cooldown; cancel always cleans.
Model check joins, timeouts, handoffs, recurrence, incident-to-planned-work linkage and compensation.
fingerprint_reconciliation: Golden fixtures for volatile-token normalization, collision/split/adversarial input, alias migrations and privacy. Shadow new fingerprint and produce merge/split impact before approval.
Replay duplicate/out-of-order/redelivery and partial API timeouts; compare scheduled inventory; verify read-after-write, human-owned drift preservation and visible SYNC_ERROR.
Retain canonical normalized key material and detect collisions; an upstream 64-bit fingerprint is grouping evidence, not a collision-free cluster or idempotency identity [S77].
diagnosis_quality: Historical time-split incidents with verified causes plus counterexamples; score evidence citation, calibrated hypothesis ranking, experiment usefulness and unsafe certainty separately. Never train/test on post-resolution clues that would not have existed at decision time.
security: Forged HMAC, replay, parser bomb, SSRF, malicious Markdown/log prompt injection, secret/PII, poisoned SARIF/artifact/cache, compromised action, dependency confusion, token exfiltration, self-approval, check spoof, audit deletion and policy drift tests.
Permission matrix tests assert denied verbs/paths/network for each identity. Execute untrusted PR code only in nonprivileged clean sandbox.
fault_chaos: Kill worker/controller at every side effect; network partition, rate limit, queue poison, DB failover, telemetry loss, stale clock, lock expiry, source resolves/reopens, Project field deletion, deploy partial success and rollback failure. Restore/replay and token-revoke drills.
release_acceptance: Exact SHA/artifact/provenance/signature binding, canary control, predeclared SLO/error budget, minimum observation and statistical/power plan. Inconclusive pauses; no missing-data-as-pass.
Game days verify abort/rollback, communications/handoff and incident evidence. Data migrations require forward/backward compatibility and compensation, not binary rollback claims.
validation_strategy.pilot_metrics: Report denominators by source/risk/class: true/false issue publication, misses, fingerprint collisions/splits, time to detect/triage/mitigate/repair, accepted/retained fixes, escaped defects, auto-action success, rollback and rollback failure, recurrence, reviewer/on-call minutes, cost and security/privacy violations.
validation_strategy.promotion_freeze: Any critical unauthorized action, evidence tampering, false safety approval, severe escape, rollback failure, policy drift or underpowered/conflicting result freezes autonomy expansion and requires review.

implementation_recommendation.core: Build a thin durable reconciliation controller around GitHub and existing observability/incident/deployment tools. Do not build a single write-capable autonomous maintenance agent.
phase_0_0_4_weeks: Commit schemas/states/policy/fingerprint fixtures/runbooks/CODEOWNERS. Create separate GitHub App identities with minimum permissions.
Ingest one user form, GitHub Actions failures and one SLO source into Postgres inbox/outbox/cluster ledger. HMAC, DLP, security-private queue and audit are mandatory.
Run read-only/shadow triage and daily source↔cluster↔issue/Project inventory. Test replay, restore, stale fencing and kill switch.
phase_1_assisted: Humans approve all publication, priority, incident action, closure and remediation. Agent summarizes evidence, asks durable questions, drafts diagnosis/plan/PR.
Add Dependabot/code scanning/security adapters and exact fingerprints. Independent clean verifier and protected merge/release remain mandatory.
Select two signed human-triggered runbooks; drill rollback and postconditions. No automatic production action.
phase_2_bounded_automation: After measured local precision, auto-create/reopen planned issues for allowlisted signals with quotas/circuit breaker; never auto-READY.
Permit deterministic abort or restore-known-good and one low-risk reversible runbook only. Sample human audits and automatically suspend on error/incident/drift budgets.
Pilot allowlisted patch dependency auto-merge only with stable supplier, no scripts/protected paths, exact-head checks, provenance, canary and easy rollback.
phase_3_governed_learning: Curate postmortem regressions under independent ownership. Automate offline/shadow and evidence production.
Human governance approves exact canary/promotion. Expand one source/action/repository/risk class at a time; retain last-known-good and kill switch.
do_not_automate: unproven rollback or general unattended self-governance
implementation_recommendation.exit_criteria: Predeclare per-class thresholds and denominators. Require zero privilege escapes/tampering, reconciled delivery completeness, acceptable false publication/dedupe and retained-fix rates, all rollback drills passing, no worse severe-escape/SLO outcome than baseline, and measured operator load benefit. Volume alone never graduates authority.

supported_claims: Renovate can automerge branches or PRs after its conditions pass; platform automerge, schedules, required tests and branch protection affect behavior.

sources.title: Noise Reduction
sources.publication_or_update_date: continuously updated; exact page date not shown

sources.title: Security and Permissions
sources.publication_or_update_date: continuously updated; exact page date not shown
supported_claims: Self-hosted Renovate needs careful token permissions and treats repository configuration as untrusted; host rules and secret exposure require controls.

sources.title: OSV-Scanner repository and documentation

sources.title: Verifying artifacts
supported_claims: Consumers should verify provenance authenticity and that artifact identity/builder/source expectations match policy; provenance is a control against substitution, not vulnerability absence.

sources.title: Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1, SP 800-218
supported_claims: SSDF calls for protecting software, producing well-secured releases, responding to vulnerabilities and retaining provenance/evidence; automation belongs inside governed practices.

sources.title: Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog
supported_claims: KEV records vulnerabilities known to be exploited and provides a high-value prioritization signal, but only for listed CVEs.

sources.title: Exploit Prediction Scoring System (EPSS)
supported_claims: EPSS estimates probability of exploitation in the next 30 days; it is a prioritization input, not impact or reachability.

sources.title: On the Use of Dependabot Security Pull Requests
sources.publisher_or_author: Alfadel, Costa, Shihab, Mkhallalati; IEEE MSR
supported_claims: Among 2,904 JavaScript GitHub projects, 65.42% of security PRs were accepted, often within one day; only 3.2% of manually examined PRs had build breakage; severity and breaking-change risk were not strongly associated with merge time.

sources.title: Dependabot and security pull requests: large empirical study
sources.publisher_or_author: Rebatchi, Bissyandé, Moha; Empirical Software Engineering
supported_claims: Dataset: 9,916,318 PR-related issues in 1,743,035 projects; Dependabot represented over 65% of dependency-management activity; fixes after PR creation often took under one day, while vulnerabilities remained hidden 512 days on average and patches were disclosed after 362 days on average.

sources.title: Details about the event-stream incident
supported_claims: A malicious dependency version entered a legitimate dependency chain, illustrating that newest/allowed versions and passing vulnerability-database checks are not equivalent to trustworthy code.

sources.title: Secure use reference for GitHub Actions
sources.publication_or_update_date: continuously updated; exact page date not shown
supported_claims: Pinning third-party actions to full commit SHAs is the only immutable release form; CODEOWNERS and least-privilege token controls reduce workflow supply-chain risk.

sources.title: Automating Dependency Updates in Practice: An Exploratory Study on GitHub Dependabot
sources.publisher_or_author: He et al.; IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering
supported_claims: 1,823 projects and 540,665 PRs; technical lag dropped after adoption; >70% PRs merged; compatibility-score availability was only 3.4%; noise and switching were observed.

sources.title: Investigating the Resolution of Vulnerable Dependencies with Dependabot Security Updates
supported_claims: 4,195 closed security updates in 978 JavaScript projects; 57% PR merge; 53.48% bot fixes, 30.27% manual, 16.25% unresolved; rejection reasons and one-year persistence quantified.

sources.title: On the Accuracy of GitHub's Dependency Graph
supported_claims: Random sample of 297 Java and 338 Python projects found dependency-graph inaccuracies that can propagate to Dependabot and GitHub SBOMs.

sources.title: Resolve code scanning alerts

sources.title: Seer

sources.title: Autofix

sources.title: Signals

sources.title: Alertmanager configuration: webhook_config

sources.title: Analysis and Progressive Delivery

sources.title: Configure Liveness, Readiness and Startup Probes

sources.title: PagerDuty Automation Actions

sources.title: The Evolution of Automation at Google
sources.supported_claims: Known, well-scoped procedures benefit from consistent automation, but thoughtless automation can create as many problems as it solves; autonomous system design is preferable to endless scripts.

sources.title: Monitoring Distributed Systems
sources.supported_claims: Alerts should be actionable and symptom/SLO oriented; noisy monitoring consumes operator capacity and undermines response.

sources.title: Cloudflare outage on July 2, 2019

sources.title: October 4, 2021 outage

sources.title: Incident Response

sources.title: Rollback a deployment

sources.title: Seer Fixes Seer: How Sentry’s Debugging Agent Helped Resolve Its Own Outage
sources.supported_claims: Feb. 21, 2026 EU incident: automatic blocklist used six raw failures, banned a mostly successful provisioned region and cascaded across fallback regions; 80–90% API failures and ~40,000 events. Seer localized mechanism, engineers supplied architectural invariant.

sources.title: Canarying Releases
sources.supported_claims: Expose a small population, compare canary/control with objective metrics and roll back; applies to remediation changes.

sources.title: DORA metrics: Four Keys

sources.title: OpenTelemetry specification status

sources.title: Collector resiliency and data loss
sources.supported_claims: Queues, retry/backoff, default eventual drop and file-storage WAL tradeoffs; observability evidence itself can be missing.

sources.title: Controllers

sources.title: Recommending Root-Cause and Mitigation Steps for Cloud Incidents using Large Language Models

supported_claims: VDP lifecycle: secure receipt, scope/contact determination, triage/prioritize, coordination, verification/remediation, reporter communication and possible advisory; maintain tracking and published policy.

sources.title: Common Vulnerability Scoring System v4.0 Specification Document v1.2
supported_claims: retain vector and distinguish Base, Threat, Environmental and Supplemental metrics; CVSS severity feeds a broader risk process and is not priority by itself.

sources.title: Service Level Objectives
supported_claims: define user-relevant SLIs/SLOs with measurement and validity conditions; compare measurements to objectives and act.

sources.title: Alerting on SLOs
supported_claims: multiwindow multiburn alerts balance precision, recall, detection and reset; published thresholds are starting points dependent on traffic and page budget.

sources.title: Prometheus canonical label-set fingerprint implementation
supported_claims: canonical fingerprint sorts labels then applies a 64-bit hash; fingerprints are not collision-free durable identities.

conflicts.conflict: Vendors describe AI root-cause/fix/remediation capabilities [S06,S24-S25,S39], while official responsible-use text and repair research show outputs can be insecure/incomplete and test-passing patches can be wrong [S07,S48].
conflicts.resolution: Treat AI output as cited hypothesis/proposal. Independent reproduction, protected tests, review and canary establish actionability; confidence never grants authority.

conflicts.conflict: Dependency bots offer automerge and fast security PRs [S01-S04,S08], while empirical studies show friction/non-merge and dependency metadata can be incomplete [S16-S17,S20-S22].
conflicts.resolution: Use bot PRs as intake. Restrict automation by package/risk/supplier/change type and exact-head evidence; keep risk acceptance and ambiguous updates human-owned.

conflicts.conflict: Kubernetes/progressive delivery offers rollback/abort [S29,S38,S40], but major outages show control changes and recovery mechanisms can amplify impact [S34-S36].
conflicts.resolution: Call rollback automatic only for drilled compatible releases and reversible effects. Configuration/data/control-plane changes require stronger gates and compensation; rollback failure escalates.

conflicts.conflict: Automation reduces toil for known procedures [S31-S32], but the same Google source warns thoughtless automation creates new problems [S32].
conflicts.resolution: Encode signed, bounded, expiring runbooks with independent postconditions; prohibit novel model-selected production commands.

conflicts.conflict: Resolved alert, green CI, closed issue and successful deployment are different success signals.
conflicts.resolution: Model separate aggregates and require retained user/SLO/security outcomes after cooldown. Never collapse denominators into tickets closed.

uncertainties: The requested as-of date is 2026-09-13. Many vendor/GitHub pages are living and undated; plan, API, schema and tenant behavior can change. Snapshot content/API versions and contract-test the target tenant before rollout.
No source proves broad autonomous observability-to-repair-to-self-improvement operation safe across repositories. Absence claims are limited because products and private deployments evolve.

Repository-specific thresholds for signal persistence, fingerprint fields, severity, cooldown, retry, evidence freshness, canary size/window, error budget and promotion sample size need local baseline/power analysis. Proposed phases are architecture, not universal constants.
False-negative intake is hard to measure because sources, dependency graphs, scanners and telemetry are incomplete. Reconciliation detects some gaps but cannot prove total coverage.
Automated rollback safety depends on real application/data/config compatibility and independently available telemetry. No generic rollback predicate exists.
Human review and incident-response capacity, privacy retention and legal/disclosure rules vary by organization and jurisdiction.
Model confidence is not necessarily calibrated for local incidents; probabilistic thresholds require calibration and drift monitoring.
The exact effect of agent assistance on retained fixes, recurrence and on-call load is unknown until a matched local shadow/pilot reports full denominators.

confidence.overall: High for architecture, state/authority separation and limits; medium for tool-specific composition; low for universal thresholds or broad autonomous safety.

claim_level.fully autonomous general maintenance and: unsupported; confidence high that current public evidence does not justify it
